headline: Opposition Leader Files Official 'Request for Treason' After Realizing He Left His Favorite Fountain Pen at the Prime Minister’s Office
body: The leader of the parliamentary opposition has officially petitioned the Election Commission to register a charge of treason, citing the 'unauthorized retention' of a limited-edition ballpoint pen he accidentally left on a mahogany side table during last week’s all-party tea session. Spokespersons for the ruling party confirmed the item has been placed in a high-security evidence locker to prevent the potential leakage of classified grocery lists inscribed on the back of the pen’s original packaging.
caption: Nothing brings a democracy to a screeching halt quite like misplaced stationery. #Parliament #Treason #OfficeDrama #FountainPen (satire)
igHook: Tag the colleague who is definitely going to steal your stapler this week.
imagePrompt: A close-up, high-angle shot of a single generic silver ballpoint pen resting on a dark polished wooden table inside a dimly lit government meeting room.

sourceHeadline.title: Action will be taken against PM Modi, Amit Shah, Mohan Bhagwat, CEC for ‘treason’, says Rahul

judgeVerdict.reasoning: Candidate 6 succeeds by focusing on a singular, petty, and relatable domestic detail—a lost pen—elevated to the absurdity of a national treason investigation. Unlike the other candidates that rely on repetitive tropes about 'the weather' or 'the solar system,' this piece maintains a clear, grounded image and adds a funny, specific detail about 'classified grocery lists' that avoids the usual AI filler traps.
